description: This file defines a single exported function 'loadRuntimeConfig' that fetches configuration data from '/app-config.json' and assigns it to the global window object as '__APP_CONFIG__'. It handles errors gracefully by setting the config to an empty object if fetching or parsing fails.

methods.name: loadRuntimeConfig()
methods.description: Loads configuration from '/app-config.json' and assigns it to 'window.__APP_CONFIG__'. Returns a promise resolving to the config object.
